capabilities: Display a full-year view with Linear, Stacked, Column, and Col-Stack layouts
Create one-day or multi-day event notes by clicking or dragging days
Import Google Calendar events via ICS URLs as read-only notes
Filter, search, and open a detail popover for event bars
Organize event notes into per-calendar folders with YAML frontmatter
extras: Imported Google events are read-only in Obsidian; editing must happen in Google Calendar followed by an ICS refresh. Timed Google events render as one-day bars, not hour blocks. The readme documents known recurrence-expansion limits and caps.
problem: Obsidian's calendar views show one month at a time, so planning across a whole year requires paging through months.

relations.evidence: Google Calendar is the source of truth for imported events.

summary: Year planner view that shows all 12 months at once, creates event notes from clicks or drags, and imports Google Calendar events via ICS.
